fact: Angola's INE opened a public consultation on 29 September 2026, running to 2 October, on the proposed new national strategy for the development of statistics, following the National Statistics Council's first extraordinary plenary on 28 August 2026.
system: Nova Estrategia Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Estatistica (ENDE)

fact: Minister of Planning Victor Hugo Guilherme referred on 13 January 2026 to the Estratégia Nacional de Desenvolvimento Estatístico (ENDE) 2015-2025 as the national statistics strategy.
